subject: CAIQ tenant-proof catalog and evidence validation process
messages:
From: Tom Kline <tkline@orionfinance.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: security@orionfinance.com
Date: 2028-03-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ ask: tenant-level evidence and control mapping

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the demo last week — Orion is moving quickly on a CAIQ review and we need one more thing before our internal board sign-off. The CAIQ asks are focused on tenant-level proofs for multi-tenant services (tenant isolation, per-tenant keying, and runtime telemetry per tenant).

Can you provide: 1) a concise control catalog that maps each relevant CAIQ control to a tenant-proof artifact (e.g., log excerpt, config snippet, architecture note), and 2) a sampling artifact set we can use to validate during the assessment (we only need representative excerpts, not full production dumps).

Deadline: Would you be able to share a control catalog and sample artifacts by EOD Wednesday (3/14)? If that timeline is tight, please propose the earliest feasible date.

Thanks — cc'ing our security team.

Tom Kline
Head of Security Programs, Orion Finance

[Attachments: none]

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Tom Kline <tkline@orionfinance.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-12T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ ask: tenant-level evidence and control mapping

Tom — thanks for the clear ask. We can meet the EOD Wed window with a scoped package and sampling plan. Outlining our deliverable set below so expectations are aligned: 

Deliverables (scoped):
- CAIQ control catalog (spreadsheet) mapping CAIQ control IDs -> Redwood control names -> tenant-level artifact type (config, log, keystore proof, architecture note)
- Tenant proof sampler (3 artifacts):
  * tenant-isolation-kv-sample.txt (sanitized KV cache access lines showing tenant namespace enforcement)
  * runtime-telemetry-screenshot.png (dashboard snippet filtered to tenant id sample-123; redacted)
  * short excerpt of our Keystore rotation record showing tenant-key metadata (redacted)
- Short narrative (1 page) explaining the sampling methodology and how it generalizes across tenants.

I'll attach a first-pass control catalog and the sampler bundle in a follow-up email (internal owners will gate anything flagged as sensitive). If Orion needs originals for the audit team, we can coordinate a scoped secure transfer (SCP link / limited-time Share).

Next steps for us internally: Kim and Marissa will review and sanitize artifacts, then I will route to you.

-Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Security & Compliance 
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood_caiq_control_catalog-draft.xlsx (in progress)]

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-13T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ ask: tenant-level evidence and control mapping — artifact gating & sanitization

Team — forwarding Orion's ask and my reply. Action items below (please treat as time-sensitive; target internal sign-off 3/14 12pm PDT):

Action items:
- Kimberly: review CAIQ catalog draft and mark any controls that reference customer-provided PII or full logs. Add a note in the spreadsheet column "sanitize_required" with suggested redaction level (none/minimal/strip-identifiers).
- Marissa: prepare the tenant proof sampler. Use sample tenant id sample-123; redact any tenant identifiers that could link to a customer. Create tenant-isolation-kv-sample.txt and include a two-line context comment describing how keys are namespaced. Add a short blurb for the one-page narrative.
- Jonas: confirm the keystore rotation excerpt can be exported without crypto material and produce a metadata only snippet. Add a note about HSM/KMS separation and tenant metadata fields.

Don't over-annotate the spreadsheet; keep the mapping concise so Orion's assessor can follow quickly. If any control requires a live demo or full logs, flag it and we'll propose a scoping limitation (sample-only).

I'll assemble the sanitized bundle and send to Tom with the narrative and a secure share link. Please reply inline with updates by EOD Tuesday.

Onward —
-Stephanie

[Forwarded message below]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Tom Kline <tkline@orionfinance.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-14T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ tenant-proof catalog and sanitized artifact bundle — Orion delivery

Tom — attaching the sanitized control catalog and the sampler artifacts per our plan. Summary: 

What we delivered:
- redwood_caiq_control_catalog.xlsx — mapping CAIQ IDs to Redwood controls and pointing to the artifact type and owner. Column "sanitize_required" indicates what we redacted for the sampler.
- tenant-isolation-kv-sample.txt — two-line excerpt showing tenant namespace enforcement in the KV key pattern (redacted).
- runtime-telemetry-screenshot.png — redacted dashboard snippet filtered to sample-123.
- keystore-rotation-metadata.txt — metadata-only snippet showing rotation event timestamps and tenant-key ID (no private key material).
- one_page-sampling-narrative.pdf (attached via secure share link) — explains sampling methodology and how the artifacts map to the control assertions.

Notes & scope:
- These artifacts are representative samples only, not exhaustive audit logs. Where CAIQ controls require full log review, we recommend a scoped on-site or secure session to review additional material under an NDA/SC access.
- For any controls that require configuration dumps, we will provide a schema-level snippet (non-production) and a signed attestation from the control owner.

Secure transfer: We uploaded the bundle to a time-limited share and emailed a link to your security mailbox. If you need another format (DocuSign package, SFTP), let me know.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether the assessor needs additional artifacts; if so, attach the CAIQ control IDs that need expansion and we'll triage.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments (delivered via secure share): redwood_caiq_control_catalog.xlsx, tenant-isolation-kv-sample.txt, runtime-telemetry-screenshot.png, keystore-rotation-metadata.txt, one_page-sampling-narrative.pdf

From: Tom Kline <tkline@orionfinance.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-14T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ tenant-proof catalog and sanitized artifact bundle — Orion delivery

Marissa / Stephanie — received the bundle and reviewed briefly. This is exactly what we hoped for; the sampling narrative is helpful. Our assessor noted two follow-ups: CAIQ control CCM_IX.1 and CCM_IK.3 need a slightly expanded telemetry excerpt (30 more lines) and an explicit attestation that keystore metadata contains tenant id as a non-secret attribute. Are you able to provide the expanded telemetry slice and a short attestation statement?

If possible, can you send the updated items via the same secure share by Friday EOD (3/17)? We'll record this as a limited expansion request rather than a full log export.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tom
Head of Security Programs, Orion Finance
